data.text:
# DAMAGE-001 Damaged products

For a delivered item recorded as damaged, offer a full refund within 14 days after
delivery, inclusive. Beyond 14 days, escalate to a human support specialist.
The full refund is the purchased quantity multiplied by the order line's unit price.
